landing.title:
One terminal.
Every market.
landing.subline: GMT aggregates real-time data from {{sources}} professional sources — equities, fixed income, FX, crypto, commodities, and Brazilian markets — into one structured terminal built for serious investors.
landing.platform_body: GMT is a real-time market intelligence platform that consolidates data from professional sources into a single structured interface. Built for investors, analysts, and finance professionals who need broad market coverage without constant context-switching.
landing.philosophy_body: The serious investor shouldn't need five browser tabs to understand one portfolio. GMT exists to change that — bringing institutional-quality market intelligence to professionals who don't have a Bloomberg terminal subscription.
landing.sources_intro: {{sources}} professional-grade APIs — each selected for reliability, depth, and coverage of the asset classes that matter most.
landing.source_fmp_desc: Real-time US equities, ETFs, FX and commodities — plus fundamentals, ratios TTM and analyst data
landing.source_eodhd_desc: Global indices, international equities and historical price series
landing.source_brapi_desc: Brazilian B3 equities, SELIC, IPCA, CDI — direct from Banco Central do Brasil
landing.source_cgfred_desc: Crypto spot prices — US macro series (Fed Funds, CPI, GDP) — live company news
landing.why_1_body: Continuous refresh cycles across all {{assets}} assets. Color-coded gain/loss, collapsible group views.
landing.why_2_body: No single API outage takes down the terminal. Automatic fallback built in.
landing.why_3_body: Group → Subgroup → Asset hierarchy mirrors MSCI GICS — intuitive for any finance professional.
landing.why_4_body: Full B3 coverage via BRAPI plus BCB macro — SELIC, IPCA, CDI — direct from source.
landing.why_5_body: Intelligent rate-limit handling keeps the terminal fast across every provider quota.
landing.why_6_body: No Bloomberg price tag. Full terminal access from day one, no credit card required.
landing.cov_body: From US equities mapped to GICS sectors, to Brazilian B3 stocks, crypto, FX, commodities, and fixed income — every market that matters to a serious portfolio.
landing.feat_body: Real-time dashboard, volume-weighted heatmap, Brazil terminal, institutional taxonomy, analyst ratings, and fundamentals — all in one structured interface.
landing.final_title:
Intelligence without
the Bloomberg price tag.
landing.final_sub: Free to start. No credit card. Full terminal access.

coverage_page.title:
Every market that matters.
All in one place.
coverage_page.subline: {{assets}} assets across {{groups}} groups — global equities, Brazil, crypto, FX, commodities, and fixed income.
coverage_page.brazil_sub: Powered by BRAPI for B3 equities and BCB SGS for macro data — direct from Banco Central do Brasil, no intermediary.
coverage_page.eq_desc: US-listed equities and ETFs mapped to GICS sectors — technology to staples — plus international ADRs, EM trackers, and B3 headline names.
coverage_page.idx_desc: S&P 500, NASDAQ, Dow Jones, FTSE 100, Nikkei 225, IBOVESPA and more. The benchmarks that define global markets.
coverage_page.fx_desc: Major and EM pairs — EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY, USD/BRL and more.
coverage_page.crypto_desc: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, XRP, Cardano, Dogecoin, Avalanche, and Polkadot. Live spot prices via the CoinGecko API.
coverage_page.comm_desc: Precious metals, energy, agriculture, and industrial metals — via futures and ETF proxies.
coverage_page.fi_desc: US Treasuries across the full maturity spectrum, investment-grade and high-yield credit, and dividend income ETFs.
coverage_page.b3_desc: Full coverage of the major B3 names — equities organized by sector, plus FIIs, ETFs, and B3 indices.
coverage_page.rf_desc: SELIC, CDI, DI curve, Tesouro Direto instruments (LFT, NTN-B, LTN), and corporate credit spreads. Data sourced directly from BCB SGS series.
coverage_page.macro_desc: IPCA inflation, GDP growth, unemployment, industrial production, USD/BRL, EUR/BRL, and liquidity indicators. Macro series from Banco Central do Brasil; FX pairs from BRAPI.
coverage_page.final_title: Ready to explore the full coverage?
coverage_page.final_sub: Free account. Instant access. All {{assets}} assets from day one.
